Story

Bilbo’s Adventure

1 Season
“Waking up, Bilbo realized he’d slept through the fight, no one had seen him.”

All had been done, no more remained. But Bilbo still needed to say a final goodbye, and get some treasure, of course.

“After helping to defeat all obstacles put upon him and his crew, from huge spiders to suspicious elves, Bilbo has been deemed a hero.”

Though, they’ve now realised, the deeper they get, the more interesting their journey becomes.

An Unexpected Party

Bilbo Baggins, a hobbit from Bag End lives his quiet everyday life when he’s suddenly visited by 13 dwarves and wizard Gandalf, who reveals that he’s their burglar.

The Journey Begins
